headline: Arete Hospitals divests 250-bed Hyderabad facility to Aurevia; KIMS assumes operations under 5-year O&M deal with call option. Business Transfer Agreement executed on 03 July 2026; O&M agreement effective from August 20, 2026.
sum: <cite index="1-3">Arete Institute of Medical Sciences Private Limited divested its 250-bed multispecialty hospital business in Gachibowli, Hyderabad, to Aurevia Hospitals Private Limited by way of a Business Transfer Agreement executed on 03 July 2026.</cite> <cite index="1-8">The hospital will be operated by Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited (KIMS) under a five-year Operations and Management Agreement.</cite>
implication: Asset-light O&M with embedded call option represents a precedent for capital-constrained healthcare groups to expand footprint in high-value urban IT hubs while deferring acquisition risk and retaining upside optionality.
detail: <cite index="1-3,1-4">TLH, Advocates & Solicitors represented Arete Institute of Medical Sciences on this transaction.</cite> <cite index="2-1,2-2">KIMS will exclusively operate Arete Hospitals in Gachibowli, Hyderabad under a long-term management agreement, with a secured call option to potentially acquire Arete's hospital business and will earn a nine percent fee on net revenue.</cite> <cite index="38-2">Aurevia Hospitals Private Limited (AHPL) is formerly known as Golden Lan Solution Private Limited.</cite> <cite index="12-4">The O&M Agreement runs for an initial period of 5 years, with an option for a further 5-year extension.</cite>
